name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Chicken Potstickers & Garlic Noodles (Remission Check)
brandOrRestaurant: Lucky Fortune Cookery (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Soft wheat-wrapper chicken dumplings are dairy-free and low-fiber, making a light side in remission (use plain soy sauce rather than chili-vinegar dip).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Potstickers as a shareable side with the Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice bowl; skip the Garlic Noodles if high-FODMAP garlic triggers bloating.
watchOuts: Potsticker filling and garlic noodles contain garlic/scallion aromatics—stick to Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice during flares
